**Analyzing Pattern Dimensions**

My recent focus has been on understanding why the model is outputting a width of 1 when I expect a wider representation, as demonstrated by the provided training pair. I'm investigating the underlying logic that leads to this dimensionality reduction, aiming to reconcile the observed behavior with expected outcomes.
